question: What result follows for a desirous person reciting this hymn of great Gaṇapati?
premises: The text is a hymn of great Gaṇapati
A person may recite it with desire
inference: Desirous recitation of this hymn initiates the attainment of wished-for results
plain_english: One who recites this hymn of the great Gaṇapati with desire...
